property_summary: For all callers and all uint inputs, the reference contract allows SetMinSum(...) to succeed only before Initialized() is called (i.e., when intitalized==false); the mutant inverts the guard so SetMinSum only succeeds after initialization, breaking this rule for inputs where SetMinSum is called prior to Initialized().
change_summary: Invert the guard so SetMinSum only works when intitalized is true (opposite of original), changing when MinSum can be set.
